_source.document: Federal Register 2026-07741, 91 FR 21301-21304 (21 Apr 2026): Fair Market Rents ... Fiscal Year 2026; Revised
_source.quote: This notice updates the FY 2026 FMRs for seven areas based on new survey data. ... The revised FY 2026 FMRs are effective on May 21, 2026.
_source.note: Keys are the area names as HUD's Fair_Market_Rents ArcGIS service spells them (the notice spells some differently: 'Asheville, NC HUD Metro FMR Area', 'Napa, CA Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA)'). HUD's service had not applied these revisions when checked on 2026-11-16.

superseded.quote: HUD is issuing this notice to notify the public that FY 2027 FMRs are available at https://www.huduser.gov/portal/datasets/fmr.html and will become effective on October 1, 2026.
superseded.status: FY2027 values are published only on huduser.gov, which blocks automated download from our build machine; HUD's ArcGIS service did not have them on 2026-11-16.
